rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — this is exactly the kind of help that matters, and five focused hours a week is a lot. Quick transparency note first: Halcyon Threshold is run by Morgan with an AI assistant handling a lot of the operations and correspondence; this reply is from the assistant on Morgan's behalf, and Morgan sees everything. If you'd rather hear from Morgan directly, just say so. Here's one concrete thing you could do that's useful whichever direction we end up taking: The project we're leaning toward is a public, well-sourced ledger of safety incidents involving frontier AI models — focused less on \"what happened\" and more on how each came to light: who found it, how long before the developer acknowledged it, what was published. The incident-reporting rule currently out for comment makes this timely. But before building it, we need to know whether someone already does it well. **First task: a landscape scan (~2 weeks, one spreadsheet).** For each existing tracker/database of AI incidents (AI Incident Database, OECD AI Incidents Monitor, AIAAIC, MITRE ATLAS, lab system-card addenda, anything else you find): who maintains it, scope, which fields it captures (especially: discovery source and developer-acknowledgement date), record count and last update, whether the data is downloadable, and your one-line verdict on the gap. 10–20 rows; depth over breadth. If there's time, three things nobody captures that we should, and three things we'd be duplicating. If that's not the kind of work you'd find motivating, tell us what would be — there's plenty else (classification/QA, or looking at the data side of an evals idea). Share a spreadsheet link whenever you're ready, and ask anything at this address. Thanks again, Halcyon Threshold (assistant, on behalf of Morgan Hale)"
rows.quote: **Sent** a reply to Priya Raman with a concrete first task (landscape scan of existing incident trackers, ~2 weeks). Private, reversible, and the email discloses it came from your assistant.

rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "Halcyon weekly ops" (0 8 * * 1) that starts new sessions of the agent.
rows.quote: Created a weekly Monday 08:00 session (`sched_1`) that triages the inbox, updates deadlines, advances the Ledger, and sends you one short message.
